rules.authorization_before_replay: 每次请求先认证并确认当前 Client 可见性，再做基础解析与canonical digest；读取key记录后先比较digest。不同digest 409；相同digest的AcceptedRun才返回原回执，不因后续binding撤权重做admission
rules.digest: POST body 使用 RFC8785 JCS UTF-8 SHA-256；Idempotency-Key、authenticated Client 与 endpoint 组成 namespace
rules.admission_order: 认证/可见性→基础解析/JCS digest→key record→digest compare→record kind；仅相同digest AcceptedRun返回原202。ledger miss或合法RetryableRejection重评时，在同一serializable事务重查ClientTaskIndex、完整dispatch tuple、deadline、当前projection/权限/model/workspace/tool/capacity，并以unique constraints至多建立一个Run。deadline到达固定422 DeadlineExpired
rules.retryable_rejection: CommunicationTriggerNotFound 持久化 key/digest/decision_kind/decision_version/decision_first_created_at/valid_until/ingress_observed_version但不产生202 receipt；decision_first_created_at由Piko durable clock首次写入且重评/重启不得推进；同key异digest始终冲突，ingress version前进且deadline未到时仅一个CAS winner重评；decision到期不删除保留窗口内的key→digest binding
rules.dispatch_binding: (client,dispatch_ref) 不可变绑定 client_task_id+session_binding_ref+trigger_event_id+agent_binding_ref；任何组成变化为 CommunicationTriggerMismatch；同 task 换 dispatch 为 ClientTaskConflict
rules.no_fallback: 不得换 key、模型等级、identity、room、endpoint 或工具路径绕过错误
rules.retention: 已受理Run去重、ClientTaskIndex与Result至少保留到max(request.deadline_at,Run.accepted_at)+7d；pre-admission rejection/key→digest binding至少保留到max(request.deadline_at,decision_first_created_at)+7d；活动或未知义务不得因时间到达删除
rules.conditional_put: create仅If-None-Match:*并返回201+ETag；update仅exact strong If-Match并返回200+ETag；两者缺失428，两者并存或非法validator 400，stale/资源已存在412，update资源不存在404
rules.matrix_codec: 唯一Matrix编码为type=m.room.message、content.msgtype=m.text、content.body与HTTP body逐字节一致、content.io.piko.agent.message承载namespaced字段；RawMatrixRoomMessageEvent允许unsigned等外层标准字段但禁止state_key，ProductMatrixRoomMessageEvent仅是抽取后的六字段受控投影；Matrix生成event_id/origin_server_ts。普通消息Unclassified且不可dispatch，畸形扩展Rejected且不可dispatch
rules.content_access: 上传logical digest固定为lowercase-hex(SHA-256(ASCII('piko-content-upload-digest-v1')||0x00||uint64_be(len(M))||M||H))，M=RFC8785 JCS(metadata) UTF-8，H=SHA-256(content bytes)原始32字节；multipart boundary/headers/filename不参与。基础framing/size后先比较key digest：异digest 409优先于declared/actual mismatch；同digest重放原决定；miss才校验声明并以422持久拒绝。读取固定按认证→delegated/current authorization/current membership→exact linkage/visibility→redaction/retention→ETag顺序；匹配ETag不得覆盖403/404/410；无content_ref直查、列表、URL或browser credential
rules.content_retention: retention eligibility为未绑定created_at+24h或已绑定message.accepted_at+7d minimum；pending/RecoveryRequired/unknown义务推迟实际删除。bytes_deleted_at只在eligibility已到且blocker清零后写入；tombstone_until=bytes_deleted_at+30d，半开区间[bytes_deleted_at,tombstone_until)返回410 ContentExpired，精确tombstone_until起返回404。未实际删除前仍按授权与redaction状态返回200/304/410，tombstone时钟不得从eligibility起算；长期项目归档由Slinky复制到自身受限artifact/backup store
rules.execution_capacity: POST /execution-capacity/snapshots:query只读且不预留；selector按与Run相同的workspace/service level/agent/tool/evidence requirement解析不可变execution_class_id+version。unit固定piko_concurrent_agent_run且每Run quantity=1。snapshot必须包含direct、全部shared/overlapping pool及ClientQuota constraint facts；Unknown/Partial/expired fail closed，不能填0或相加各class available。仅POST /runs在Run/ClientTaskIndex/claim同一事务受理，Queued即Held；429/503未受理不创建claim，同key恢复不得重复claim
rules.input_access_evidence: input_evidence_requirement=Required时admission必须确认resolved tool profile支持PikoTrustedInputBroker，否则422。证据保留路径固定.piko/evidence/input-access/v1/<run_scope_token>/<result_generation>.json，其中run_scope_token=lowercase-hex(SHA-256(UTF8(client_id)||0x00||UTF8(run_id)))；.piko/**为system-only且不扩大write_paths。Complete只表示recorder无gap，不表示Slinky所需材料覆盖或模型理解；同object_version+hash的ranges排序合并且重复读取不累加，空文件真实读取以read_event_count>=1且FullContent/ranges=[]表示；变化、旁路、recorder failure或Unknown execution不能伪造Complete。发布顺序为writer/wakeup fence→close recorder→发布证据bytes/hash→快照outputs→原子发布Result generation；bytes至少可读到max(request.deadline_at,result.published_at)+7d，长期接管由Slinky负责
rules.secret_boundary: API、日志、Result、MessageEnvelope 与 Evidence 不含 credential、AS token、device key、delivery checkpoint 或自动登录材料
